meta.name: Aranyak 2021
meta.description: After a foreign teenage tourist goes missing in a misty village, Kasturi, a frazzled local cop, is forced to team up with her city-bred successor, Angad, on a high-profile case that unearths skeletons and resurrects a long-forgotten legend of a savage serial killer in the woods.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Amid a tense handover on the eve of a sabbatical, Inspector Kasturi Dogra is shaken by a teen’s disappearance and fears of a murderous creature in town.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Keen to work on the case, Kasturi tussles with Angad for power. A tip-off leads to a source who may have implicating testimony — until danger strikes.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Angad and Kasturi probe into Kanti’s whereabouts on the night of Aimee’s murder. Angad suspects cafe owner Govind in the attack on Sundar.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A suspect makes an unconvincing confession. Kasturi and Angad begin to doubt one of their own. Manhas gets under Ashok’s skin. Nutan receives a shock.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: An unknown number in two suspects’ call records raises more questions. As tension with Hari builds, Kasturi and Angad attend a wedding at Manhas’s home.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As the unknown caller is identified, damning video footage elicits confessions from both Ravi and Julie. Nabbing Omi becomes Angad's central concern.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Bunty comes clean, paving the way for truths to emerge about Manhas, Hari, Gagan and Kanti. Nutan makes a drastic attempt in distress.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: One key finding about Aimee’s rape lets Kasturi and Angad extract more confessions from that fateful night — and beyond. Mahadev identifies the Nar Tendua.
